geometry.scope: per-instance uploaded geometry; shared per-mesh decoding guards unchanged

textures.factor_policy: white: sRGB8 hardware decode; nonwhite: standard EOTF times linear factor, FP32 texture; material uniform white
textures.shader_semantics: SAPIEN 3.0.3 default/gbuffer.frag and rt/camera.rchit replace baseColor when diffuse texture exists

studio.units: positions and emitter half sizes in metres; colors linear relative radiance
studio.soft_shadow_method: official RT samples emitter surface and traces finite shadow rays
studio.reflection_method: official diffuse/GGX direct area-light estimator plus traced HDR environment
studio.support: path_trace RGB only; no raster studio approximation

environment.source_quantization: RGBE shared 8-bit mantissa; default 0.125 is exact
environment.orientation: uniform all directions; world-Z-up panel recipe
environment.source_lifetime: owned temporary file until scene close

backend.display: exposure=1; clamp linear [0,1]; standard sRGB OETF; half-up UNORM8
backend.readback: blocking SAPIEN get_picture CPU download, then owned bytes
backend.seed_note: sampling_pattern specifies the actual shader and device scope

sampling_pattern.frame_count_policy: first render of a newly constructed camera each exposure
sampling_pattern.scope: same installed shader/device/config; repeated public bytes audited in device test

backend.accumulation: fresh camera per exposure; no temporal history
backend.pt_clip_limit: all vertices inside near+0.002/far and range<9999m, with FP32 clearance
backend.pt_precision_policy: 8*FP32-epsilon*transform-scale clearance; reject >=1% scene span; pragmatic admission, not a global error proof
backend.shader_probe: selected shader executed and CPU target read back
backend.global_config_note: camera default mutations serialized/restored inside this adapter only

lifecycle.scope: this scene attachments only; no driver/cache/process-memory release claim
